name: Identifier Dependency Audit

methodology.tmdb_lookup_dependency: TMDb records retain the IMDb identifier used in the lookup.
methodology.movieLens_role: Shared identifier cross-reference; not independent proof.
methodology.direct_dbpedia_tmdb_ids: Extracted from DBpedia metadata without inferring missing values.

limitations: The audit traces recorded identifier relationships, not every internal API operation.
IMDb and TMDb metadata are not automatically independent identity evidence.
A shared MovieLens identifier is a cross-reference, not independent identity proof.
Direct identifier absence in retrieved DBpedia metadata does not prove global absence.
No identity was automatically verified or merged.
